original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹朱巴-蒙德里公路遭伏击后交通恢复
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州朱巴-蒙德里公路在发生伏击事件后，人员和车辆通行据报已恢复正常。9月26日在该路段被绑架的78余名平民已于10月1日获释。官员提醒旅客保持警惕，称武装犯罪分子可能仍在丛林中活动。

location.raw_text: Juba-Mundri Road in Western Equatoria State

key_facts.fact: 朱巴-蒙德里公路人员和车辆通行据报已恢复正常
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Movement of people and vehicles along the Juba-Mundri Road in Western Equatoria State has reportedly returned to normal

key_facts.fact: 9月26日在该路段被绑架的78余名平民于10月1日获释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: more than 78 civilians who were abducted along the Juba-Mundri Road on 26 September were released on 1 October 2026 after spending up to four days in captivity

key_facts.fact: 官员提醒旅客保持警惕，称武装犯罪分子可能仍在丛林中活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He cautioned that the absence of newly reported incidents did not mean the area was completely safe, noting that armed criminals were still believed to be operating in the bush.

uncertainties: 通行恢复情况据报，尚未获独立证实
武装犯罪分子是否仍在丛林中活动尚未证实
是否有其他犯罪事件尚未报告，官员表示不知情
事件信息目前仅来自单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）
